scope: Built image default entrypoint, Caddy/Octane/Horizon/Redis/Workerman, isolated SQLite and real container restart

checks.check: Default container starts embedded Redis, Horizon and Caddy/Octane with a migrated database
Administrator logs in through the published Caddy port
Administrator HTML and built JavaScript/CSS load with matching integrity hashes
New member receives VLESS and Hysteria2 subscription credentials
HTTP backup creation and download succeed as www with gzip and native SQLite headers
Caddy forwards real WebSocket Upgrade and authenticated node full sync
Disabling a member revokes both connected nodes through Horizon and rejects the subscription
Container restart preserves administrator login, panel assets, member token/UUID and disabled state
Node HTTP and WebSocket full sync do not resurrect the disabled member after restart
Member restoration after restart reaches both nodes and restores the same subscription
HTTP SQLite backup remains writable and downloadable after container restart
